key.name: launcher
key.description: Which home screen the home gesture opens: Phosh's own app grid or Neo. The patched Phosh (phosh 0.58.0-1+neo1 or later) reads this key; Mobile Settings shows it on the device page.

key.name: home-widgets
key.description: The weather and an analog clock across the top two rows of the first page.

key.name: desktop-hide-app-labels
key.summary: Hide labels on the home screen

key.name: icon-pack
key.description: Directory name of an icon pack under /usr/share/neo-launcher/iconpacks or ~/.local/share/neo-launcher/iconpacks (pack.json, gnome-map.json, icons/); empty: the theme's icons.

key.name: icon-wrap-unthemed
key.summary: Wrap icons the pack does not cover in its own background

key.name: icon-shape-legacy
key.summary: Draw icons without pack art on a shaped background

key.name: search-drawer-enabled
key.summary: Search field at the top of the app drawer

key.name: hidden-from-home
key.summary: Apps removed from the home screen (still in the drawer)

key.name: wallpaper-parallax
key.description: A directory with parallax.json and its layer pictures (back to front); the layers shift by their depth as the phone tilts. Empty: the GNOME wallpaper, still.

key.name: lock-type
key.description: pin: Phosh's keypad. pattern: a 3x3 dot grid on the lock screen, the dots in order are the password. swipe: no password (Phosh's require-unlock off).
